title: EVICPRESS: Joint KV-Cache Compression and Eviction for Efficient LLM Serving
technique: joint lossy compression + eviction placement across storage tiers via a utility function

optimized_metrics.evidence: minimize average generation latency without hurting quality

headline_claim.text: EVICPRESS achieves up to 2.19x faster time-to-first-token (TTFT) at equivalent generation quality

extractor_notes: Abstract-only extraction. Objective stated as "average generation latency"/delay; the measured result is TTFT.
